cards.audioText: [Your call sign is AFR101, your destination is Paris, you are going to depart from Beijing airport at Gate 301. Now call Beijing Delivery, and request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是法航101，目的地巴黎，从北京出发，301号机位，现在联系北京放行，请求放行。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, AFR101, Gate 301, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，法航101，机位301，请求放行。

cards.audioText: AFR101, cleared to Paris, via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600m, RENOB32 departure, request level change for 10400m en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，可以按计划航路放行至巴黎，起始高度6600米。RENOB32离场，在航路上申请巡航高度10400m，应答机1725，跑道36右，离场频率127.75。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Paris, via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600m, RENOB32 departure, request level change for 10400m en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路放行至巴黎，起始高度6600米，RENOB32离场，航路申请更改巡航10400米，应答机1725，跑道36右，离场频率127.75，法航101。

cards.audioText: [You are ready for pushback and startup, call Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【已准备好推出开车，联系地面。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, AFR101, (Gate 301) request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，法航101，（301号机位）请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: AFR101, Beijing Ground, short delay for pushback, an A340 inbound for Gate 302.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，北京地面，稍等推出，一架A340在302号机位进位。
cards.referenceText: Roger, short delay for pushback, AFR101.

cards.audioText: AFR101, pushback approved. [Ask ATC the direction of pushback.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，同意推出。【向ATC询问推出方向。】
cards.referenceText: Pushback approved, request direction for push back, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出，请求推出方向，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, my apologies, pushback and startup approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，抱歉，同意推出开车，头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and startup approved, facing east., AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，头朝东，法航101。

cards.audioText: [All engines have been started, everything checked out normal, received information G, request taxi from Beijing Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【发动机都已起动，一切检查正常，收到通播G，向北京地面请求滑行。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, AFR101, information G, ready for taxi/request taxi instruction.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，法航101，通播G，准备滑出/请求滑行指令。

cards.audioText: AFR101, information G changed, information H is available. [Report that you have received H but you want to change runway 01 for a short course.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，通播G更改，当前通播为H。【报告你已收到通播H，但你想减少滑行距离更换至跑道01。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, information H received, request runway 01 for a short course, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，通播H，由于滑行距离，申请跑道01，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, roger, B737 inbound is approaching from left for Gate 303, once that aircraft is cleared, taxi via B and D, hold short of runway 01. [You received report from information H that B is closed.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，收到，一架波音737从303号机位左侧滑行入位，737一离开，你就可以沿滑行道B，D滑行至跑道01外等待。【你收到通播H，滑行道B已经关闭。】
cards.referenceText: ATIS H says that taxiway B is closed, confirm taxi via B, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播H显示滑行道B已经关闭，确认是否从B滑行出，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, correction, taxi via M and D, hold short of runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，更正，沿滑行道M，D滑行至跑道01外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via M and D, hold short of runway 01, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道M，D滑行至跑道01外等待，法航101。

cards.audioText: [Now you are airborne. Contact Beijing Departure, you are passing 1200m and climbing to 1800m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在已起飞。联系北京离场，正在过1200米，往1800米爬升。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, AFR101, passing 1200m climbing to 1800m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，法航101，通过1200米，正上升至1800米。

cards.audioText: AFR101, Beijing Departure, identified, climb to 6000m on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，北京离场，已识别，上升标压6000米。

cards.audioText: [Flight attendant reports that there is a man carrying explosives on his body and attempting to detonate them. Require emergency descent to 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【机组人员报告称有一名男子身上携带爆炸物，并试图引爆它。请求紧急下降至3000米。】
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Departure, AFR101, request descent to 3000m, a man is carrying explosives on his body and attempting to detonate them.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，北京离场，法航101，请求下降至3000米，一名男子身上携带爆炸物，并试图引爆它。

cards.audioText: AFR101, roger, descend to 3000m on QNH 1011. Say endurance. [Readback and report that you can hold for 2 hours more.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，收到，下降到3000，修压1011，报告续航时间。【复诵并报告你可以坚持2个多小时。】
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000m on QNH 1011, endurance 0200, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到3000，修压1011，续航时间2小时，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, roger, divert immediately to Tongzhou.[Request radar vector to Tongzhou.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，立即改航去通州。【请求雷达引导去通州。】
cards.referenceText: Request radar vector to Tongzhou, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导至通州，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, turn right heading 180, maintain 3000m. When able, report current conditions on board. [Readback and then give a report that the dangerous man is still struggling and has hurt two passengers.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，右转航向180，保持3000。如果可以，报告机上目前状况。【复诵并报告该危险男子仍在挣扎，有两名乘客受伤。】
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, maintain 3000m. The man is struggling and two passengers are hurt, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向180，保持3000。该男子仍在抗争，两名乘客受伤，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, roger, say intentions. [Tell the ATC that the man has finally surrendered, the two passengers are in dangerous situation, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，收到，请示意图。【告诉ATC该名男子最终被控制住了，两名受伤乘客处于危险状态，请求返回北京机场并优先降落。】
cards.referenceText: The man is under control now, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing, two passengers are in critical condition, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 该名男子已被控制，请求返回北京机场并优先降落，两名乘客受伤严重，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, roger. Cleared runway 18R, you are number one. Police officers and medical services will be ready on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，收到。可以降落跑道18右，你第一个。到达时警察和医疗服务都已准备好。
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道18右，第一个，谢谢，法航101。
